rule: plan 90 §90.3.1 with design general/topics/relevant, howdecided, prominent, howto; keys = signed EORS psy general (labs, ekg, imaging, guidelines, screenings, workup); PAEA Psychiatric & Behavioral Health 2026 list; Leader S10 ruling (selection recorded here, general.json written in S12)

labs.why: Only medication-monitoring and rule-out labs are needed (design general/topics/relevant example; signed mockup psy:labs prominent false, how labs); her guide has no labs section.

items.item: Lithium level
items.covers: Bipolar I disorder; Bipolar II disorder (her guide: Lithium row, BPD PHARM)

items.item: Renal function (BUN/creatinine) and electrolytes
items.covers: Lithium monitoring — Bipolar I disorder (her guide: Lithium row monitoring BUN/Cr, electrolytes)

items.item: TSH and calcium/PTH
items.covers: Lithium monitoring (hypothyroidism, hyperparathyroidism) — Bipolar I disorder (her guide: Lithium row TSH/PTH, calcium); TSH also in the workup of Major depressive disorder (her guide: Dementia Overview row)

items.item: Valproate level, LFTs, CBC with platelets and ammonia
items.covers: Valproate monitoring — Bipolar I disorder (her guide: Valproate row)

items.item: Carbamazepine level, CBC, LFTs, BUN/Cr, UA, sodium, eye exam/IOP; HLA-B*1502 before starting
items.covers: Carbamazepine/oxcarbazepine monitoring — Bipolar I disorder (her guide: Carbamazepine row)

items.item: Pregnancy test before teratogenic mood stabilizers
items.covers: Valproate, carbamazepine, lithium — Bipolar I disorder (her guide: Valproate row, fetal-risk warning)

items.item: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) for clozapine
items.covers: Clozapine — Schizophrenia (her guide: Clozapine row)

items.item: Metabolic monitoring: fasting glucose/HbA1c and lipid panel
items.covers: Second-generation antipsychotics — Schizophrenia; Schizoaffective disorder; Bipolar I disorder (her guide: SGAP rows)

items.item: Prolactin
items.covers: Antipsychotic hyperprolactinemia — Schizophrenia (her guide: Risperidone row, Tuberoinfundibular pathway row)

items.item: Sodium (hyponatremia/SIADH)
items.covers: SSRIs — Major depressive disorder; carbamazepine/oxcarbazepine — Bipolar I disorder

items.item: Electrolytes, magnesium, phosphate and amylase in eating disorders
items.covers: Anorexia nervosa; Bulimia nervosa; Avoidant/restrictive food intake disorder; refeeding syndrome (her guide: Anorexia and Bulimia diagnostics, Refeeding syndrome note)

items.item: Urine drug screen
items.covers: Substance-related disorders; new psychosis — Schizophrenia, Brief psychotic disorder (her guide: Schizophrenia exam/workup)

items.item: Blood alcohol level, LFTs (AST:ALT), GGT and MCV
items.covers: Alcohol-related disorders (her guide: Alcohol row)

items.item: Acetaminophen and salicylate levels after an ingestion
items.covers: Suicidal behaviors (overdose)

items.item: Creatine kinase (CK)
items.covers: Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (her guide: NMS row); stimulant intoxication — Stimulant-related disorders (her guide: Stimulants row)

items.item: Medical rule-out labs for new psychiatric or cognitive symptoms: CBC, CMP, TSH, B12/folate, RPR, HIV
items.covers: Major depressive disorder; Schizophrenia; Brief psychotic disorder (her guide: Dementia Overview row, Psychosis row)

ekg.why: Only QTc and drug-related changes are needed (design general/topics/relevant and prominent: her psych guide has no arrhythmia section; signed mockup psy:ekg prominent false, how ekg).

items.item: QTc prolongation
items.covers: Antipsychotics — Schizophrenia (her guide: FGAP/SGAP rows, Ziprasidone); citalopram/TCAs — Major depressive disorder (her guide: SSRIs, TCAs rows); methadone — Opioid-related disorders (her guide: Methadone row); pitolisant — Narcolepsy (her guide: Pitolisant row)

items.item: TCA toxicity: wide QRS, terminal R in aVR, sinus tachycardia
items.covers: Major depressive disorder (TCAs); Suicidal behaviors (overdose) (her guide: TCAs row)

items.item: Lithium changes: T-wave flattening/inversion, sinus node dysfunction
items.covers: Bipolar I disorder (her guide: Lithium row — cardiac arrhythmia, abnormal T waves)

items.item: Clozapine myocarditis: sinus tachycardia and ST/T changes
items.covers: Schizophrenia (her guide: Clozapine row — EKG, troponin)

items.item: Baseline cardiac evaluation before stimulants
items.covers: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (her guide: Stimulants row)

items.item: Bradycardia, QT prolongation and hypokalemia changes (U waves)
items.covers: Anorexia nervosa; Bulimia nervosa (her guide: Anorexia nervosa row — QT)

items.item: Ischemia and arrhythmia in stimulant intoxication
items.covers: Stimulant-related disorders (cocaine) (her guide: Stimulants row)

imaging.why: Imaging is used only to rule out structural causes and for specific complications; her guide has no imaging section.

items.item: Brain MRI/CT to exclude structural causes in first-episode psychosis or catatonia
items.covers: Schizophrenia; Brief psychotic disorder; Catatonia

items.item: MRI patterns of the dementias (diffuse cortical atrophy, white matter lesions, frontotemporal atrophy)
items.covers: Her guide: Dementia table (Alzheimer, Vascular, Frontotemporal rows)

items.item: DEXA bone density
items.covers: Anorexia nervosa (osteopenia/osteoporosis)

items.item: Neuroimaging to exclude neurologic disease when indicated
items.covers: Functional neurologic symptom disorder
